configs.description: The finger duct as FS ships #315743, cover fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: no FS document held states a cable capacity for CMH-SFDS2U: the datasheet that covers it has no Cable Capacity Reference Guide, and the cable managers portfolio lists only dimensions. The product page could not be read (403 from the shop front).
gaps.wanted: the capacity row of the product page, or a capacity table in a later datasheet
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - style, sides, material and the UL 94 V-0 rating of the finger ducts are the Technical Specification table and overview of the FS High Capacity Horizontal Cable Managers datasheet (portal id 7671); indoor its Environment row.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom row of fingers is the top row again.

capacity.note: not stated - no capacity is carried: the high capacity datasheet has no capacity figure and the cable managers portfolio gives dimensions only, so the figure is the `cable-capacity` gap below, not a datasheet fact.

chassis.note: drawing - THE BODY BETWEEN THE EARS. 482.6 over the ears; the cover between them reads 293 of 321 px, 440, the body every steel duct of this family shares. The ears, 20.6 each, are not drawn. Height 88.0 is the cover, the same height as the ears on the front view, and the spec table; depth 116.0 the plan and the spec table (116.02).

color.note: estimated - no colour row in the datasheet; every render is black, drawn in the shades CMH-SFDS1U reads off its renders.

fingers.note: drawing - ten fingers a row on the plan, in a three-finger and a seven-finger moulding, the same T-shaped finger as CMH-SFDS1U at the same pitch; 44.0 is taken so that ten fill the 440 body. The fork of each stem is drawn as the stem.

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted, as the front view draws it: 440 x 88 with four hinge clips, two on the top edge at 75.0 and 341.8 from the left end and two on the bottom at 119.4 and 297.0, the stagger CMH-SFDS1U carries. The finger rows are 9.0 thick and 4.7 in from the top and bottom, ESTIMATED: the drawing has no side view, and they are taken from the same moulding on CMH-SFDS1U and CMH-DFDS2U.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the backbone is the mounting plane and the duct stands 116 mm in front of it (the plan of the datasheet), so the rear face of its two rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - the duct on the front view is the channel between the finger rows, run across the rack.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn; the end elevation is built from the plan depths and the estimated rows. The duct is open at both ends.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS High Capacity Horizontal Cable Managers datasheet (portal id 7671) draws CMH-SFDS2U as a plan and a front view, dimensioned 482.60, 465.00, 88.03, 76.20 and 116.02. The embedded image is small (543 x 425, carrying a watermark): 0.666 px/mm across the 482.6, 0.668 down the 116.02 and 0.648 down the 88.03, so it is near orthographic but resolves only about 1.5 mm. The straight-on renders of #315743 (front and back) are the second reading.

rear.note: photo-measured - the back from gallery image 3, a straight-on render, at 3.015 px/mm across the 482.6 between the ear ends: three rounded rectangular windows 300 to 304 px wide, 100 mm, and 103 px high, 35 mm at the 88 of the plate, 50 apart, drawn symmetric about the middle from 20 to 420 across the body; the corner radius, 6, is estimated.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT. A sheet body whose six views are elevations; the solid is the backbone as a well 114 deep with its three windows open, the two rows of fingers in it, and the cover, which comes off. The rear view builds the back of the backbone as sunk plates round the windows.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states the gauge; 1.2 is taken, as for the other FS steel managers in the library.

top.note: drawing - the plan, rear at y=0: backbone, blocks to 31.8, stems, heads from 95.4, and the cover edge.

weight.note: datasheet - 0.85 kg, the FS product page specification for #315743, as read at intake. It is less than the 1.04 kg of the 1U CMH-SFDS1U; recorded as FS states it.
